leh-manali-highway-sarchu-leh.title: Leh–Manali Highway: Sarchu to Leh
leh-manali-highway-sarchu-leh.slogan: Sarchu to Leh, over 5328 m · one way, about 350 km back to the start

waypoints.name: Sarchu
waypoints.advice: Sarchu is where the day begins. Next is Lachulung La.

waypoints.name: Lachulung La
waypoints.advice: Lachulung La comes up 117 km in. Next is Tanglang La, climbing 269 m.

waypoints.name: Tanglang La
waypoints.advice: 233 km in you reach Tanglang La. The road climbs 269 m on the way up to it, steadily. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Leh, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Leh
waypoints.advice: Leh closes the day.

sections.advice: Sarchu → Lachulung La climbs about 5059 m in 30 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Lachulung La → Tanglang La is 10 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Tanglang La → Leh drops about 5328 m over 134 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

leh-manali-highway-sarchu-leh.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the named road Leh–Manali Highway. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: Leh–Manali Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 16.8%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter. First and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.

scenicChapters.title: Leh–Manali Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it. The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 5328 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Tanglang La → Leh
scenicChapters.narrative: 269 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it — this is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

leh-manali-highway-sarchu-leh.story: It goes by way of Lachulung La and Tanglang La. The highest point is about 5,350 m. Lachulung La and Tanglang La are open in summer only - check it is open before you set off. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
